allowed: sealed file relative paths, sizes and SHA-256
raw table names and schema-required fields
flat JSON scalar values for lossless typed-Parquet conversion
row counts, field names, scalar types, ordered whole-row digests and ordered recordId digests
runtime, peak memory, file counts and byte counts
prohibited: effects, directions, rankings, weighting or winner adjudication
using qualification observations as formal samples
note: Reading scalar row content is authorized solely to validate lossless serialization; no metric is aggregated or interpreted.
